title: House-Battery State-of-Charge Watch
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nmea:reading measurement=battery
| timechart span=15m min(soc_pct) as soc by bank
| eval low=if(soc<50,1,0)
description: Trends the house-battery charge on board and warns before it falls too low to run the fridge, lights, and pumps.
value: Flat house batteries at anchor mean warm food and dead instruments; an early warning lets you run the engine in time.
implementation: Ingest battery telemetry into `index=personal`; alert on low state of charge per bank.
visualization: Line chart of battery state of charge by bank.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks the boat's batteries and warns before they run too low to power the fridge and lights.
